messages:
ashley: Proposing a quota-aware stepper for model upgrades. Goal: percent-based ramps but gated by per-customer quota headroom (tokens/sec + monthly commit) so we don't accidentally push heavy tenants into throttles. Draft config below, open to alternatives.

```
ramp:
  steps:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 10m
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 2
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 5
    - pct: 20
      duration: 1h
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 10
  fallback:
    on_quota_violation: revert-to-previous
    cooloff: 15m
sampling:
  telemetry_rate: 0.01
  trace_sample_rate: 0.01
```

miguel: question — for shared/dedicated customers how do we compute "quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec"? rolling 5m consumption + buffer? :thinking:
devex-sam: UX note: console should show an "effective tokens/sec headroom" inline with the slider and light up warnings. default telemetry sampling for ramps should be 1% so we don't overload metrics.
olga: operational concern: we currently export token usage at 1m granularity. gating at 10s or 30s is better for quick aborts. will need pipeline changes.
india: also watch daily/monthly quota resets (midnight UTC). If a ramp hits right before reset it can look like tons of headroom but then get cut off. need a guard for monthly percent used per-tenant.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary config validated against schema v2.1 — warnings: sampling.telemetry_rate missing or too low for immediate detection.
nashley: updated config in-thread: added `quota_window: 5m`, explicit `sampling.telemetry_rate: 0.01` and gating on error_rate/latency. new snippet: 

```
ramp:
  steps:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 10m
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 2
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 5
    - pct: 20
      duration: 1h
      quota_headroom_tokens_per_sec: 10
  gating:
    error_rate_pct_lt: 1.5
    latency_p95_lt_ms: 2000
    quota_window: 5m
  fallback:
    on_quota_violation: revert-to-previous
    retries: 3
    cooloff: 15m
sampling:
  telemetry_rate: 0.01
  trace_sample_rate: 0.01
```

miguel: :thumbsup: can we add a "ramp_heatmap" telemetry panel that shows pct vs headroom over time? useful to spot customers who are at risk.
devex-sam: i'll mock the console detail view — small heatmap tile next to the slider, expand to timeline. show abort CTA + reason. CTA should surface tenant list impacted.
olga: i'll raise a PR to the perf pipeline to emit 10s token metrics and a rolling_avg_5m field. ETA: 3 days.
nashley: decision summary: implement quota-aware stepper + revert-to-previous fallback with 3 retries and 15m cooldown. gating conditions: error_rate < 1.5%, latency_p95 < 2s, and per-tenant monthly_used_pct < 80% (block ramp). telemetry: metrics sampling 1%, traces 1%, heatmap panel. follow-ups: olga -> perf PR, devex-sam -> console mock, miguel -> doc update.
india: small ask — ensure ramp evaluation respects burst credits and does not treat them as permanent headroom. maybe require sustained headroom for 2 consecutive quota_window intervals.
sre-bot: INCIDENT-POST: note — last month's throttling spike (2026-02-14) would have been caught with a quota-aware gate. Good to have this in place.
nashley: i'll open the RFC and tag infra + platform. thanks all! :party_parrot:
